review_text: The full-grain leather quality is astounding for this price point. Wore them all week in the office with zero blisters.
Runs at least half a size too small! I normally wear 9.5 US and my toes were totally pinched. Exchange process took nearly 3 weeks.
Gorgeous packaging and very comfortable insole. Deducted one star because the laces started fraying after three weeks.
Ordered express shipping for a wedding and it arrived 6 days late. Customer service said no refunds on shipping. Call me at 555-839-2011 to fix this.
Best minimalist sneakers on the market. Better arch support than Common Projects at half the price.
The aesthetics are a 10/10, but the heel slip is noticeable. Had to buy silicone heel grips to make them wearable.
Super fast delivery to Mexico City. The unboxing experience felt luxury, and the leather smells incredible.
Sole came unglued at the toe box after just one month of light walking. Contacted help@store.com and received an automated bot reply.
Water resistance is surprisingly good in light rain. True to size for wide feet if you size up.
The color in person is much darker than shown on the website photos. Dark charcoal looked almost jet black under sunlight.
Third pair I have purchased from this brand. The durability and timeless silhouette make them my daily driver.
Return label fee was $15 deducted from my store credit! Why charge for returns when your sizing chart is inaccurate?
Customer support agent Andrea was a hero. Resolved my address typo within 10 minutes on Sunday morning.
Comfortable, but they squeak on linoleum and tile floors when walking. A bit embarrassing in quiet office hallways.
Great sustainable materials. Breathable during hot summer days. Will order the high-top version next.
Took 24 days to clear customs in Spain. Website did not disclose international import VAT was not included.
Incredible sneaker. Sleek enough to wear with a suit, comfortable enough for 15,000 steps around New York.
Credit card was charged twice and the return department has not responded for 10 days. Horrible after-sales service.
The memory foam footbed is life changing for standing desks. Worth every single penny.
